panels.title: Service Liveness (Prometheus scrape health)
panels.description: Real Prometheus `up{job=...}` per backend service -- 1 means the last scrape of that service's /metrics succeeded, 0 means it did not (Phase 11 architecture §3.7).

panels.title: Service Readiness (dependency health)
panels.description: Real `service_readiness{service}` gauge (Phase 11 closure) -- 1 when that service's last dependency check (the same `check_database_connection()` /health/ready already uses) passed, 0 otherwise. Refreshed on the same cadence Prometheus already scrapes /metrics on -- no new scrape target, no change to /health or /health/ready's own contract. gateway_service has no database (§3.7) and is intentionally absent from this panel.

panels.title: 5xx Error Rate by Service
panels.description: sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total{status_code=~"5.."}[5m])) -- real server-side/downstream failures (Batch 3), never a fabricated health score.

panels.title: 4xx Rate by Service
panels.description: sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total{status_code=~"4.."}[5m])) -- expected client-facing errors (Batch 3 severity classification), shown separately from 5xx so an expected 404/409/etc. is never read as an operational failure.
